projects.title: AI Capital
projects.description:
Building an AI-powered investment platform using Python to automate qualitative research and predictive modeling.

- Integrated 5+ financial APIs (EDGAR, FRED, Tiingo, etc.) with AWS S3 to process 40+ years of multi-asset market data.
- Built SEC filings summarization with RAG (LLMs + chunked embeddings).
- Developed time series and ML models for multi-horizon price prediction with engineered technical and macro features.

projects.title: Football Win Probability Model
projects.description:
- Created a model with Matplotlib data visualization that determines and displays a team's win probability during the course of a game, based on play by play game data
- Wrote game data scraper using BeautifulSoup that works on all NCAA/NFL games after the year 2000
